frames.pose: Hammer is low at a slight diagonal, ready over the workstand.
Begin lifting. Right elbow bends and hammer rotates up to a 45 degree angle.
Highest pose. The hammer head is over the right corner of the goggles. A small lean back on the fixed waist.
Mid-downstroke smear. A narrow muted steel sweep follows the hammer. Hold the same core silhouette and feet.
Fast contact. The flat face lands exactly on the coin. The mitt still grips the handle.
Short rebound, the hammer face lifts clearly off the coin, just a few pixels at sticker size.
The mitten eases the hammer back to its waiting angle, clear of the coin.
A tiny satisfied smile holding the opening hand and body positions.
